input.change_text: Improved memory usage for `--resume` (68% reduction for users with many sessions) by replacing the session index with lightweight stat-based loading and progressive enrichment

output.subject: --resume memory usage cut 68% via stat-based loading
output.action_text: Upgrade Claude Code to 2.1.30+ if you maintain many resumable sessions and have been hitting `--resume` memory pressure. The full session index is replaced with stat-based loading + progressive enrichment, cutting RSS ~68% on heavy-session users. No flag required.
